filename_encoding: Original poi_id with % encoded as %25 and : as %3A, plus .jpg; reversible via decodeURIComponent on filename stem.

selection.basis: Manual landmark selection, informed by 18 deterministic heuristic-profile plans per city, existing POI tags/opening-hour snapshots and availability of clearly licensed photographs. Production popularity is uniformly 0.5, not observed visitor popularity.

profiles.providers: local routes, no realtime, heuristic preference

selection.limitations: Selection is not complete coverage. Image dates and opening hours are historical source snapshots, not realtime assertions.
